theater: 上巴里赫河谷、埃德薩西南

battle.name: 尼赫里亞戰役
battle.theater: 上巴里赫河谷、埃德薩西南
battle.brief: 公元前1237年春，亞述軍越過幼發拉底河東岸，攻入上巴里赫河谷的尼赫里亞，與赫梯王圖德哈里亞四世所部接戰。亞述取得決定性勝利，赫梯王位一度動搖。此時的埃及月牙劍早已退居禮器，戰場上真正吃重的是複合弓與雙人戰車。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 交戰雙方是上古近東的兩大國家：亞述帝國與赫梯王國。亞述方面由中亞述時期的沙爾馬努阿沙雷德一世（Šulmānu-ašarēd I，約前1264至前1234年在位）統帥，按保守解讀，其子圖庫爾蒂-尼努爾塔一世（公元前1243至前1207年在位）才是直接在尼赫里亞交手的亞述君主。亞述王權此時已完成從米坦尼手中奪取美索不達米亞上游的轉折，王家常備軍以步兵、弓手與雙人戰車為骨架，並靠委任總督與移民屯墾來經營新取得的土地；對西北山區的奈里（Nairi）諸部，亞述長期徵收貢賦，人數多達四十位小國王。赫梯方面由圖德哈里亞四世（Tudḫaliya IV，約前1237至前1209年在位）執掌，他是前王哈圖西里三世之子，於前1267年父王廢黜姪子穆爾西里三世而自立後出生，兄弟爭位留下的裂痕尚未癒合。赫梯仍保有阿拉美斯（Aleppo）與卡爾凱美什（Carchemish）兩個行省，以及西奈的海上盟友烏加里特；被亞述吞掉的哈尼加爾巴特（Ḫanigalbat）原是赫梯的附庸國，那裡的國王在亞述與赫梯之間反覆倒向，直接點燃了戰端。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the two great powers of the ancient Near East: Assyria and the Hittite kingdom of Hatti. On the Assyrian side the war belonged to the Middle Assyrian king Šulmānu-ašarēd I (reigned c. 1264–1234 BC), although a conservative reading of the fragments makes his son Tukulti-Ninurta I (1243–1207 BC) the Assyrian ruler who actually fought at Nihriya. Assyria had by then completed its turn inward after the fall of Mitanni, taking over the upper Mesopotamian provinces that once belonged to the old Mitanni empire; its royal army was built around infantry, archers and two-man chariots, and its administration worked the new country through appointed governors and the settlement of deportees, while it levied tribute for decades on the tribal polities of the Nairi highlands, at one point as many as forty local kings. On the Hittite side the ruler was Tudḫaliya IV (c. 1237–1209 BC), the son of Hattusili III, born after his father had deposed the nephew Muršili III and seized the throne in 1267 BC, so that the wound of the fratricidal succession was still fresh. Hatti still held the provinces of Aleppo and Carchemish and the coastal alliance with Ugarit; Hanigalbat, formerly a Hittite vassal state, had been swallowed by Assyria, and its kings, shuttling between the two empires, provided the immediate occasion for the war.
people: 決定命運的人分屬兩個世代。赫梯一方的核心是圖德哈里亞四世：他在即位前已目睹赫梯在上巴里赫河谷與哈尼加爾巴特方向的全面退卻，戰敗之後更面臨數場針對其王位的內亂，靠個人威望一一平定，保住王位。此時亞述的國王是沙爾馬努阿沙雷德一世，他致信西奈盟友烏加里特的國王（書信 RS 34.265），在信中描述了自己這一輪西征的經過與結果，這封信是今日重建此役的主要依據。另一種解讀則把交戰的亞述君主定為其子圖庫爾蒂-尼努爾塔一世——這位君主在銘文中誇稱自己渡過幼發拉底河、攻入赫梯地盤，並把多達兩萬八千八百名赫梯居民強制遷往亞述。學者方面，專攻亞述與哈尼加爾巴特的阿米爾·哈拉克整理了亞述方面的王權材料；傑瑞德·米勒推翻舊說，證明尼赫里亞並非上底格里斯河的奈里地區，而在上巴里赫河谷；馬西莫·福拉尼尼與戈伊科·巴爾亞莫維奇先後把戰場範圍縮到埃德薩（Şanlıurfa）周邊五十公里之內，並提出圖爾納、特爾戈蘭等候選遺址；讓-弗雷與馬佐耶則整理了散佚的赫梯與烏加里特文書，把殘篇拼接成可用的戰史。
peopleEn: Those who decided the outcome belong to two different generations. At the centre of the Hittite side stands Tudḫaliya IV: before he even took the throne he had watched Hatti retreat everywhere in the Upper Balikh valley and along the Hanigalbat frontier, and after the defeat at Nihriya he had to face several revolts aimed at his person, which he put down one by one through sheer prestige and so kept the crown. The Assyrian king at the time was Šulmānu-ašarēd I, who wrote to the king of Ugarit, the Hittite ally on the coast (letter RS 34.265), describing the course and the outcome of his western campaign; that letter is the principal source from which the battle is reconstructed today. A second interpretation makes the Assyrian commander his son Tukulti-Ninurta I, whose inscriptions boast that he crossed the Euphrates, struck into Hittite territory and deported as many as 28,800 Hittite subjects to Assyria. Among the scholars, Amir Harrak, specialist in Assyria and Hanigalbat, assembled the Assyrian royal material; Jared Miller overturned the old identification and showed that Nihriya lay in the Upper Balikh rather than in the Nairi country of the upper Tigris; Massimo Forlanini and Gojko Barjamovic then narrowed the battlefield to within some fifty kilometres of Şanlıurfa and proposed candidate mounds at Turna and Telgoran; Jean Freu and Michel Mazoyer collated the scattered Hittite and Ugaritic texts, piecing the fragments into a usable campaign history.
kits: 這張卡牌的兵器是埃及月牙劍（Khopesh），一件外彎的單刃青銅短劍；到公元前1500年前後，它在埃及已退居象徵性的地位，是王室與神廟的禮器，也是象形文字裡表示劍的標準符號，在盧克索與卡爾納克的神廟浮雕上，與法老並肩而立的常是這把月牙形的古劍。真正決定尼赫里亞勝負的武器是別的東西：亞述與赫梯的步兵裝備青銅矛頭的長矛、短柄斧、直刃匕首與短劍，背負圓盾或柳條盾；雙人戰車由御者與射手組成，車上另備箭囊與長矛；遠射主力是亞細亞式角弓與複合弓所配的箭矢，銅或骨製箭頭配合箭袋，供應由遠征隊列沿途徵集。亞述方面的攻城配備包括斜坡、擋牆與坑道，同時以擄掠與遷徙維持戰時供給；圖庫爾蒂-尼努爾塔一世把多達兩萬八千八百名赫梯俘獲者押往亞述，正是這種以人口代替軍事物資的戰爭經濟的寫照。馬匹方面，除王室御用馬群外，還有從奈里山區徵得的一百二十八匹馬的購馬紀錄，說明這場戰爭的機動能力依賴高地的馬源。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Egyptian khopesh, a bronze short sword with a strongly curved single edge; by around 1500 BC it had already retreated in Egypt to a symbolic role, an object of royal and temple ritual and the standard sign for the sword in hieroglyphic writing, and on the temple reliefs of Luxor and Karnak it is the crescent-shaped antique blade that so often stands shoulder to shoulder with the pharaoh. The weapons that actually decided Nihriya were quite different: the infantry of Assyria and Hatti carried spears with bronze heads, short-handled axes, straight daggers and short swords, and bore round shields or wicker shields; the two-man chariot carried a driver and an archer, with a quiver and spears carried on the car; the main missile arm was the Asiatic angular bow and the composite bow, with bronze or bone arrowheads and quivers whose supply was drawn along the line of march. The Assyrian siege equipment included ramps, revetments and sapping tunnels, while the war was sustained by plunder and deportation; Tukulti-Ninurta I's claim to have deported up to 28,800 Hittite captives to Assyria is the clearest expression of a war economy that fed itself with people instead of stores. In the matter of horses, besides the royal herds there is a record of a purchase of 128 horses from the Nairi highlands, which shows that the mobility of this campaign rested on the highland sources of mounts.
tactics: 亞述的戰法倚賴速度與縱深：軍隊自美索不達米亞中部出發，沿幼發拉底河東岸北上，在渡口與支流匯合處強渡或架橋，隨後以戰車支隊先行掃清道路、掩護步兵縱隊推進，最後在目標城邑前合圍。以尼赫里亞一役看，亞述先是把哈尼加爾巴特的附庸逐個收編，切斷赫梯在幼發拉底河東岸的前哨，然後深入上巴里赫河谷，切入哈蘭與埃德薩之間的糧倉地帶，逼迫赫梯王不得不以主力來戰。赫梯的應對則是退回河谷縱深，以戰車群與密集步兵結成的盾牆守住通往哈蘭的通道，等待亞述隊伍因遠離補給基地而拉長戰線，再以小隊襲擾其側翼與糧道。戰後的殘酷手段是人口強制遷徙：奪取城邑之後，亞述把居民成批押往亞述本土安置，用以填補新征服地區的人力。戰事其後又延續約五年才停，最後以一份維持下來的和約收場。
tacticsEn: Assyrian method relied on speed and depth. The army set out from middle Mesopotamia, moved north along the east bank of the Euphrates, forced or bridged the fords where tributaries joined it, then sent chariot detachments ahead to clear the road and screen the marching infantry column, closing on the objective settlement at last. In the case of Nihriya, Assyria first reduced the vassals of Hanigalbat one by one, cutting the Hittite outposts on the east bank of the Euphrates, and then drove deep into the Upper Balikh valley into the granary country between Harran and Edessa, forcing the Hittite king to commit his main force. The Hittite answer was to fall back into the depth of the valley, to hold the road to Harran with chariot groups and a shield wall of close-packed infantry, and to wait until the Assyrian columns, drawn far from their supply bases, stretched out, and then to send detachments to harry the flanks and the supply line. The harsh measure of the aftermath was forced deportation of populations: when a settlement was taken, the Assyrians marched its inhabitants off in batches to Assyria itself, to man the newly conquered country. The war itself ran on for some five years more before it stopped, and it ended with a peace that was actually kept.
data: 可用的數字不多，但每一個都重要。亞述王沙爾馬努阿沙雷德一世的在位年表為前1264至前1234年，學者涅米羅夫斯基依赫梯泥板 KBo IV 14 推算，尼赫里亞之戰約在其在位終止前十年，也就是接近前1244年；另一派則把它推至前1230年上下，本站採用戰爭列表所載的前1237年。赫梯王圖德哈里亞四世在位約前1237至前1209年，其父哈圖西里三世約前1267至前1237年，也就是說這場戰役正好壓在哈圖西里廢黜姪子穆爾西里三世、赫梯內部還未完全穩定的年份上。戰果方面，圖庫爾蒂-尼努爾塔一世自稱把兩萬八千八百名赫梯居民遷往亞述；同一君主又自稱擊敗奈里地區四十位小國王、迫其納貢，另有泥板記載一次向奈里購馬一百二十八匹。至於戰場位置，米勒主張在埃德薩或哈蘭周邊五十公里內，巴爾亞莫維奇提出的圖爾納與特爾戈蘭兩處遺丘則在埃德薩東北偏東六十六至七十七公里。
dataEn: Few numbers survive, but each of them matters. The reign of the Assyrian king Šulmānu-ašarēd I is dated 1264–1234 BC; from the Hittite tablet KBo IV 14 Nemirovsky computed that the battle of Nihriya fell about ten years before the end of that reign, that is around 1244 BC, while another school places it near 1230 BC; this site follows the year 1237 BC given in the list of wars. The Hittite king Tudḫaliya IV reigned about 1237–1209 BC and his father Hattusili III about 1267–1237 BC, so the battle fell precisely on the years when Hatti had not yet settled after the deposition of Muršili III. On the score of results, Tukulti-Ninurta I claimed to have deported 28,800 Hittite inhabitants to Assyria; the same ruler claimed to have beaten forty local kings of the Nairi country and forced them into tribute, and another tablet records the purchase of 128 horses from Nairi at one time. As for the place of the battle, Miller argues for an area within some fifty kilometres of Şanlıurfa or Harran, while the mounds at Turna and Telgoran proposed by Barjamovic lie 66 to 77 kilometres east-northeast of Şanlıurfa.
cause: 開戰的成因是多層的。最表層是地理與資源的爭奪：亞述自米坦尼覆亡後便沿幼發拉底河向東推進，先取哈尼加爾巴特，再占據東岸要衝，取得的正是上美索不達米亞的穀物產區與通往安納托利亞東部的通道；只要亞述站穩這一段，赫梯在敘利亞的門戶就暴露在對方打擊之下。第二層是附庸國的忠誠問題：哈尼加爾巴特的諸王既曾向赫梯納貢，又被迫向亞述交租，兩強都以對方在區內的作為為藉口，戰爭成了清理對方勢力的手段。第三層是赫梯王室的內亂：哈圖西里三世廢掉姪子穆爾西里三世奪位，父子之間的裂痕與各地親王的野心同時爆發，圖德哈里亞四世在即位之初便腹背受敵；他在尼赫里亞一戰的失敗，使原本指向內部的懷疑轉為指向國王本人，亞述正是趁這個空檔發動了西征。
causeEn: The causes of the war were layered. At the surface lay a quarrel of geography and resources: after the fall of Mitanni Assyria had pushed east along the Euphrates, first taking Hanigalbat and then seizing the strategic points on the east bank, and what it gained was precisely the grain country of upper Mesopotamia and the road into eastern Anatolia. Once Assyria stood firm on that stretch, the Hittite doorway into Syria lay exposed to Assyrian blows. The second layer was the loyalty of the vassal states: the kings of Hanigalbat had paid tribute to Hatti and were forced to pay tax to Assyria as well, and each of the two powers used the other's conduct in the region as a pretext, so that the war became a means of clearing the rival out of its own sphere. The third layer was the disorder inside the Hittite royal house. Hattusili III had deposed his nephew Muršili III and taken the throne, and the rift between father and son broke out at the same time as the ambitions of the provincial princes, leaving Tudḫaliya IV, newly enthroned, attacked from every side. His defeat at Nihriya turned suspicion that had pointed inward against the king himself, and Assyria moved west into the opening.
impact: 尼赫里亞之役的後果超出戰場本身。對赫梯而言，這是一場震動國本的敗仗：亞述取得決定性勝利，赫梯王位一度被數場內亂包圍，圖德哈里亞四世雖最終平定反抗、保住王位，國力卻大為削弱，赫梯把注意力從西北邊疆抽回國內，反而把重心放到南方與埃及維持外交，並倚重西奈盟友烏加里特的海上力量。對亞述而言，這是它第一次以中原霸主的姿態在西北美索不達米亞站穩腳步，尼赫里亞一帶被納入亞述的行政與移民體系，幼發拉底河東岸與哈蘭走廊從此成為亞述西部邊界線之一，也開啟了亞述往黎凡特與安納托利亞方向推進的漫長路徑。對當地居民與土地而言，這場戰爭開啟了亞述大規模強制遷徙的傳統，戰俘與居民被成批押往亞述本土，過去的附庸聚落被拆散重建，此後數百年上美索不達米亞的人口版圖都受這類政策影響。總體而言，尼赫里亞之役是青銅時期晚期亞述崛起、赫梯西翼崩解的關鍵一步。
impactEn: The consequences of Nihriya reached well beyond the field itself. For Hatti it was a defeat that shook the state to its foundations: Assyria won decisively, the Hittite throne was for a time ringed by revolts, and although Tudḫaliya IV eventually mastered the rebellion and kept his crown, the power of the kingdom was badly diminished; Hatti drew its attention back from the north-western frontier to the interior, and instead weighted its diplomacy towards the south and Egypt while leaning on the sea power of its Levantine ally Ugarit. For Assyria it was the first time the middle Mesopotamian power had established itself in the far north-west, with the country around Nihriya drawn into the Assyrian administrative and settlement system, the east bank of the Euphrates and the corridor of Harran becoming part of the Assyrian western frontier, and the long road opened towards the Levant and Anatolia. For the population and the land of the region, the war inaugurated the Assyrian practice of mass deportation on a large scale: prisoners and residents were marched off in batches to Assyria itself, and old vassal settlements were broken up and resettled, so that the population map of upper Mesopotamia would bear the mark of such policies for centuries afterwards. In the wider view, the battle of Nihriya was the decisive step in the rise of Assyria and the coming apart of the western wing of Hatti in the Late Bronze Age.
result: 結果是亞述的完勝。尼赫里亞一役，亞述軍在決定性的交鋒中擊潰赫梯主力，赫梯失去對哈尼加爾巴特與上巴里赫河谷的控制，尼赫里亞及其周邊土地被亞述接管；圖庫爾蒂-尼努爾塔一世的銘文更宣稱把兩萬八千八百名赫梯居民遷往亞述本土，這個數字很可能有所誇大，但方向無疑：亞述打算用人口與屯墾把這片新地變成永久的前線基地。赫梯沒有崩潰，圖德哈里亞四世在內亂中重新站穩，國家也繼續存在了數十年；此後戰事再延續約五年，雙方最終議和並把和約維持下去，亞述與赫梯退回各自一方的邊界。必須說明的是，此役的記載極為殘缺：今日所知的尼赫里亞戰役，主要靠烏加里特書信 RS 34.265、赫梯泥板 KBo IV 14 與 KUB XXIII 99 等零星殘片拼湊而成，戰役的確切年份、參戰君主與具體戰場位置至今仍在爭議；能確定的只是，公元前13世紀上半葉，亞述第一次在西北美索不達米亞打贏了赫梯，而赫梯的西翼從此再也沒有收復。
resultEn: The result was a complete Assyrian victory. At Nihriya the Assyrian army broke the Hittite main force in a decisive engagement; Hatti lost control of Hanigalbat and of the Upper Balikh valley, and Nihriya with the land around it passed under Assyrian administration. The inscriptions of Tukulti-Ninurta I go further and claim that 28,800 Hittite inhabitants were deported to Assyria proper; the figure is probably inflated, but the direction of it is not in doubt, for Assyria meant to turn this new country into a permanent forward base by means of people and settlement. Hatti did not collapse: Tudḫaliya IV regained his footing through the revolts and the kingdom survived for further decades; the war dragged on for some five years more, and the two powers finally made peace and kept it, each falling back behind its own frontier. It must be said that the record of this battle is very fragmentary. What is known of the battle of Nihriya today has been pieced together from the Ugarit letter RS 34.265, the Hittite tablets KBo IV 14 and KUB XXIII 99 and similar scattered fragments; the exact year of the fight, the identity of the commanders and the precise location of the field are still disputed. What can be certain is only this: in the first half of the thirteenth century BC Assyria defeated Hatti for the first time in north-western Mesopotamia, and the western wing of the Hittite state was never recovered.
